messages:
kai: Starting intake for this quarter's pentest. Scope: staging k8s (read-only), metrics ingest, and an evidence S3 bucket. Need RBAC plan, KMS grant pattern, and retest process. Quick sync at 11?

marta: I can join. Preference: ephemeral role per engagement + presigned uploads blocked, vendor to AssumeRole for traceable CloudTrail.

devops: Proposed flow: vendor assumes role pentest-assessor-{vendor}-{ts} with max session 3600s. S3 tmp upload to tmp/{assessment-id}/ then sealing lambda moves to sealed/{assessment-id}/ and applies SSE-KMS (alias/pt-evidence-cmk). Add object lock Governance on sealed/.

ops-oncall: We'll create a temp KMS grant scoped to the role. Command example: `aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-evidence-cmk --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/pentest-assessor-{vendor}-{ts} --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey` Record GrantId in tracker and revoke after window. Also add CloudWatch metric for AssumeRole failures.

security-bot: Enable CloudTrail multi-region + log-file-validation. Require vendors to include EncryptionContext {"assessment-id":"<id>"} on KMS requests. Add checksum (sha256) as object metadata.

kai: Re test window — vendor requested 10 days. Security preference: fresh role + grant per retest. We'll automate creation/teardown via CFN change set and a runbook.

marta: Action items: devops to post CFN outline, ops-oncall to make grant runbook, kai to create tracker entry and schedule sync.

devops: Will post CFN draft today. Note: ensure ChangeSet + manual approval before apply. Also block presigned PUTs in bucket policy.

ops-oncall: I'll add pager rule for suspicious assume attempts and an automated verification that sealed/ objects have SSE-KMS + ObjectLock before closing intake.

kai: Great. If no objections I'll add this plan to the intake ticket and invite vendor. Sync 11 invite sent. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
